facts.text: Augustana University operates on an academic calendar featuring a 15-week fall semester, a 3.5-week January Interim (J-Term), and a 15-week spring semester.

sources.title: Academic Calendar - Augustana University
sources.quote: The Augustana University academic calendar includes a 15-week fall semester, 3.5-week January Interim (J-Term) and 15-week spring semester. Students may also participate in summer college in June and/or July.
